Maya (People Ops): Liam submitted resignation this morning. Last day 2025-05-02. Need to schedule exit interview, confirm benefits cutoff, and lock down cloud roles.
Sam (Manager): Thanks, Maya. Liam owns the perf-test SA and has access to vault/enc-keys. I'll coordinate the runbook transfer.
IT-Helpdesk (Tom): Do we know if Liam has any hardware beyond laptop? Docking station? VPN token?
Liam Chen: Just the Macbook, power brick, and a YubiKey. I'll drop the kit at reception on 05/02 before 11am.
Maya (People Ops): Great. Benefits note: medical ends 2025-05-31 (end of month). COBRA packet will be mailed 2025-05-03 and emailed same day. Final payroll will include unused PTO and will process on 2025-05-15 payday.
Offboard Bot: Task created: "Collect asset form - Liam Chen" due 2025-05-02. Link: https://tasks.redwood.com/asset-1939000001
Security (Aisha): Important: do not remove vault decrypt access until a new owner is confirmed. List of steps:
```
- Add sam@redwood.com as vault key-owner for kv-prod-enc
- Transfer perf-test-sa ownership to infra-team@redwood.com
- Run decrypt test by 2025-05-01
- Rotate keys 24h after successful tests
```
Sam (Manager): I'll add infra-team and open a PR to transfer GitHub repo admin and Jenkins job ownerships. Expect to finish by 2025-04-29.
IT-Helpdesk (Tom): Proposed SSO deactivation: keep active through morning of 05/02, revoke at 17:00 PT. We'll run ./revoke-sso --email liam@redwood.com --revoke-ssh-keys at 17:00.
Liam Chen: 17:00 revocation works for me. I'll finish handover before then.
Maya (People Ops): Exit interview: can we do 2025-05-05 10:00 PT? HR + Manager.
Liam Chen: Yes, works.
Security (Aisha): One more: search for any personal deploy keys or SSH keys on build hosts. If found, remove and rotate agent keys. I'll run the scan and post results.
IT-Helpdesk (Tom): Scan scheduled for 2025-04-28. If keys found, auto-revoke script will run.
Maya (People Ops): Quick recap of actions: 1) IT: collect assets and run deprovision 05/02 17:00 PT. 2) Security: perform key handoff and rotate after tests. 3) Manager: transfer ownerships + accept service account. 4) People Ops: send COBRA notice 05/03 and schedule exit interview 05/05. Please react with :white_check_mark: when complete.
Tom (IT): ✅ I'll post a completion message after deprovision.
Aisha (Security): ✅ Vault ACLs updated, awaiting decrypt results.
Sam (Manager): ✅ Transfer PR merged, reviewers assigned.
Liam Chen: Thanks everyone — appreciate the thoroughness. 🙏
